utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the timing got shuffled around, and a couple jobs moved up earlier than I first thought. I can give you the quick version if you want it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare gloves and a roll of tape we can put toward it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, that covers the gloves and tape. I’m bringing the tape, screws, and a wrench if I can find one, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, we’re covered on the basics then. I’ll bring the gloves and see if I can find anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be here after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo. We’ve got the plan set, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving from here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Gus. I’ll be here after lunch if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’m still in for the repair drive. Tell Rosa I’m ready for the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll tell Rosa you’re ready and we can go over the details together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’m still in and happy to go over the details with you and Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive is confirmed for today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s confirmed for today. I’m keeping things moving and will let everyone know the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, just the time then?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and they still could use a couple extension cords and a hand truck if anyone’s got extras lying around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then let’s start by checking the list and see who can bring the cords and hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, I’ll check the list with you and see who can cover those cords and the hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help once I know the time, the location, and a short list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll send you the time, location, and the short bring list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, send it over and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, send the time and the short list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I’ll send the time and the short list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts Saturday morning, so I can work around pickup after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great — I’ll have the front porch shelf and the loose step covered Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I can handle the hallway lights and the door after pickup too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help, Rosa, but I still need the list of repairs and the location before I can keep everyone on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got it, Vik — I’m sending the repair list and the location now so you can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, send it over and I’ll keep the others moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s start with the easiest one first: the loose hinges.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, then let’s get those hinges tightened first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the schedule and who’s covering materials before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now. I can cover the materials and help set the afternoon time once we check the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps. Once you confirm the afternoon time, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ve got the front porch shelf and the loose step covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still need the schedule and the materials plan before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can put together the schedule and materials list if you want, but I’ll need the current plan from whoever’s coordinating the drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We still need extra drill bits, a pry bar, and someone to haul the lumber.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm the repair time and who’s covering the materials?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Repair time is 9 a.m., and I’ve got the materials covered except for the extra drill bits and pry bar - Dane’s hauling the lumber and bringing drill bits, so we just need the pry bar.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, it sounds like things are really coming together. They could still use a couple extension cords and a hand truck if anybody has spares.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check around for any spares and get the word out if you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s confirmed for today, but I want to double-check the time before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Hana. Let me know the time once you confirm it, and I’ll keep the others posted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik. I’m checking the time now, then I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Start with the broken steps so nobody gets hurt.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that, but I still need the list of repairs and the location before I send anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s the broken steps at the north path, plus the loose hinges and leaky faucet after that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, give me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Quick version: we check what needs fixing, then line up this afternoon. I can haul the lumber and grab the drill bits.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts Saturday morning, right? I can plan around pickup if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Saturday morning at 9 still works. Meet by the tool shed, and bring gloves and any hand tools you have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, I’ll be there Saturday at 9 by the tool shed with gloves and a couple hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’m still in for the repair drive. Tell Rosa I haven’t forgotten.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara. I’ll let Rosa know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli. I appreciate it, and I’m keeping my part of the repair drive in mind.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me. I’ll bring my gloves and hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s start with the loose hinges and the broken steps first; I’ll point out the worst ones when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m a bit behind too, but I heard the repair drive is underway and people are still organizing drop-offs. What’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Last I heard, it’s moving along and drop-offs are still being organized. I’m still good after lunch if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks. I’ll be there after lunch too if you want to compare notes on the drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list tight and I’m keeping the urgent fixes at the top. I’ll send you the details next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps a lot. I can send you the spots and names I’ve already got so Jules can start matching them up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, mostly the timing shifted and a few jobs got moved up sooner than I had in my head. I can give you the quick rundown if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can give you the quick rundown: the timing shifted a bit, and a couple of jobs got pulled forward sooner than I had in mind.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
